'Oldest university in present-day Germany' is disputed: Erfurt claims the title through its 1379 papal founding privilege, but it opened only in 1392 and was closed from 1816 to 1994. The body now names Heidelberg (1386) as the oldest and the first to open, explains Erfurt's claim, and the notes say the same.
